scientific_finding: Average concurrent flame spread rate measured at approximately 1.8 mm/s in the specified SIBAL test
engineering_implication: Flame spread behavior depends on the tested configuration and cannot be generalized to all spacecraft materials

scientific_finding: Flame spread along the edges of a structured PMMA specimen reached up to 0.88 mm/s for 1 mm ribs
engineering_implication: Surface structure and ventilation can affect observed flame propagation under the tested conditions

scientific_finding: Under certain conditions n-heptane droplets continued low-temperature cool-flame burning after visible flame extinction
engineering_implication: Visible flame extinction alone does not prove that combustion has fully ceased

scientific_finding: Examine PMMA ignition and extinction as airflow oxygen pressure and radiant heating vary
engineering_implication: Study objectives identify conditions of interest but do not establish a measured outcome
